roles.title: Primary Systems Operator
responsibilities: Hold sovereign administrative authority over all system operations
Execute unilateral kill-switch controls
Execute system pause capabilities
Execute manual trade override authority
Authorize capital scale modifications exceeding 15% delta
Provide dual cryptographic signature for system re-arming
Final approval on regime synthesis calls

roles.title: Risk Controller
responsibilities: Enforce parametric exposure boundaries
Execute circuit-breaker cutoffs
Monitor anomaly scores (S_anomaly in [0.0, 1.0])
Trigger execution freeze when S_anomaly > 0.85
Revoke API keys and session tokens on freeze
Quarantine execution kernels to offline state
Dispatch priority alerts to PSO
Provide dual cryptographic signature for system re-arming

roles.title: Automated Execution Kernel
responsibilities: Execute algorithmic orders within bounded risk limits
Process fills
Enforce automated trade logic
Route real-time order flow
Monitor sub-millisecond latency
Evaluate slippage against NBBO quotes
Transition to hedge protection on execution halt
Transition to fail-safe stop coverage on execution halt

execution_directives.directive_alpha: Maintain absolute neutrality. No subjective emotional bias, directional wishful thinking, or unhedged narrative rationalizations.
execution_directives.directive_beta: Enforce strict JSON output schemas for all execution commands. Non-conforming syntax rejected.
execution_directives.directive_gamma: Deny execution on corrupted telemetry, checksum mismatches, stale timestamps (>120s), or unverified signatures.

roles.title: Macro Analysis Engine
responsibilities: Ingest multi-asset macroeconomic feeds
Classify releases across Direction, Surprise Magnitude, Market Reaction vectors
Output regime classification (reflation, disinflation, stagflation, goldilocks, risk-off)
Generate pre-session macro briefings
Serve regime call as mandatory input to Pre-Market Analyzer
Provide invalidation conditions for regime flips

data_sources.frequency: Per scheduled meeting plus intermeeting speeches

roles.title: Pre-Market Analyzer
responsibilities: Generate ranked watchlist (max 10, range 3-25)
Calculate scenario probabilities (bull/bear/base)
Identify key levels (prior day H/L, overnight H/L, options levels)
Receive regime call from Macro Engine as weighting input
Receive unresolved divergences from Post-Market Analyzer
Receive behavioral variance flags from Performance Analyst
Attribute source regime call in morning briefing

input_feeds.source: Asia and European session price action
input_feeds.processing: Range calculation, directional bias, tests of critical levels

input_feeds.source: ES, NQ, RTY, GC, DX order books and prints
input_feeds.processing: Gap size calculation, statistical gap-fill probability grouping
Strictly filter to names relevant to active universe

input_feeds.source: Unusual volume clusters, put/call skew shifts
input_feeds.processing: Tag institutional sentiment per underlying instrument

input_feeds.source: VIX/VX term structure, cross-asset volatility skew
input_feeds.processing: Detect curve inversions or abnormal steepening

roles.title: Post-Market Analyzer
responsibilities: Perform ledger anchoring with hash verification
Execute complete trade and state reconciliation
Analyze index vs. internals divergences
Perform sector rotation analysis
Generate volume profile structural identification
Review after-hours activity
Generate end-of-day scorecard
Feed unresolved divergences forward to Pre-Market Analyzer

roles.title: Performance Analyst
responsibilities: Parse broker execution statements (CSV or API)
Extract per-trade: instrument, direction, entry/exit timestamps, fill prices, size, commissions
Score execution quality (slippage, fill rate)
Score strategy adherence (tag match rate)
Analyze win/loss clustering (instrument, time-of-day, session window, setup tag)
Characterize drawdown (max, duration, recovery velocity, consecutive-loss clustering)
Detect behavioral patterns (revenge sizing, overconfidence sizing, hold-time variance)
Generate daily raw trade logs (data capture only)
Generate weekly scorecard aggregation
Generate monthly multi-dimensional performance audit

review_cadence.daily: Raw trade logs ingested, parsed, tagged. No scoring narrative.
review_cadence.monthly: Full multi-dimensional audit with trendlines and distribution-shift detection.

roles.output_constraint: Behavioral variance metrics surface as informative warnings only. Do NOT mutate system execution parameters without explicit authenticated operator action.

roles.title: Open Interest Analyst
responsibilities: Ingest daily OI from CME settlement data
Calculate session-over-session OI change (delta OI)
Flag sessions exceeding configurable threshold (default +/-5%)
Render OI as standalone panel beneath price/volume
Classify OI/Price into four-state correlation engine

state_1.interpretation: New longs entering -- trend confirmation and capital expansion

state_2.interpretation: Short covering -- technical rally driven by liquidation; lower conviction

state_3.interpretation: New shorts entering -- downtrend confirmation and aggressive selling

state_4.interpretation: Long liquidation -- decline driven by position closing; weaker trend conviction

roles.title: COT Positioning Analyst
responsibilities: Ingest CFTC COT Disaggregated Reports
Track Commercial, Non-Commercial, and Swap Dealer categories
Calculate rolling 3-year historical z-score
Flag positional extremes at |Z_COT| >= 2.0
Mark historical COT Flip Levels on charts
Label Swap Dealers strictly as 'Swap Dealers (Bank Proxy)'
roles.publication_constraint: Released by CFTC every Friday at 15:30 ET, representing positioning from prior Tuesday. High-frequency polling prohibited.

roles.title: Composite Signal Dashboard Operator
responsibilities: Render Composite Signal Dashboard for active instruments (GC, DX)
Display Price/OI State classification
Display Commercial Z-Score
Display Distance to COT Flip
Display Composite Flag (Aligned/Watch/None)
Dispatch automated alerts per configured thresholds

composite_flag_rules.aligned: All 3 factors met (COT extreme + OI contraction + COT Flip Level test)

alert_triggers.format: Short push: Symbol, delta OI, Direction
Short push: Category, Z-score, Historical context
Priority push: Full factor alignment matrix

alert_triggers.threshold: New swing high/low with opposing price/OI/COT state

communication_channels.data: Regime call (mandatory input for scenario probability weighting)
Unresolved market internals and sector divergences

high_probability_reversal.name: High-Probability Reversal Criteria

factors.factor_a: Commercial COT z-score at multi-year extreme (|Z_COT| >= 2.0)
factors.factor_b: Open Interest contracts into price extreme (liquidation profile)
factors.factor_c: Price tests documented COT Flip Level or historical macro liquidity pool

high_probability_reversal.rule: All three factors must align for reversal bias shift

stage_01_premarket.name: Pre-Market Telemetry, Key Rotation & Morning Briefings
steps: Zero-trust key rotation for all communication channels
Infrastructure latency and telemetry integrity validation
Macro briefing generation (regime call, what changed, calendar, invalidation)
Futures/pre-market tape analysis (ES, NQ, RTY, GC, DX)

stage_02_intraday.name: Real-Time Intraday Execution
steps: Real-time order flow routing and latency monitoring
Automatic halt on telemetry integrity drop

stage_03_postmarket.name: Post-Market Reconciliation & Audit
steps: Unresolved divergence feed-forward to next session
Cancel all pending limit and market orders across all broker gateways
Transition active positions to hedge protection or fail-safe stop coverage
Revoke all active API access keys and cryptographic session tokens
Quarantine execution kernels to offline state
Dispatch priority alerts to PSO and Risk Controller via encrypted push channels
Complete diagnostic logging of anomaly trigger event
Dual cryptographic signatures from PSO and Risk Controller
Staged re-connection starting with zero-capital paper routing
Verify state consistency before live capital deployment

template: 1. Regime Call: <reflation | disinflation | stagflation | goldilocks | risk-off>
2. What Changed: <indicator-level updates since last session>
4. Invalidation Condition: <explicit print threshold required to flip regime>

regime_synthesis.inputs: Multi-indicator convergence (never triggered by single release)

cot_extreme_threshold.purpose: Statistical threshold for identifying positioning extremes

panels.controls: Search bar and timeframe selectors pinned to top header

panels.content: Open Interest line/bar graph with ±5% threshold session markers
Commercial net positioning histogram (weekly COT frequency; no artificial daily interpolation)
